Description
Introducing the “Silver Bullet” Collection, a series of .999 fine silver bullion pieces designed in the shape of collectible ammunition. This collection is highly sought-after by numismatists, investors, and gun enthusiasts alike, and offers a unique and distinctive piece to add to any individual or dealer’s precious metals vault.
One of the standout pieces in this collection is the 10 oz. Silver Bullet .50 Caliber Rounds. These rounds replicate the size and shape of an actual .50 caliber round that can be used in the M2 Browning Machine Gun. This iconic gun has been used by the US military since the 1930s and has played a pivotal role in numerous conflicts such as World War II, The Korean War, The Vietnam War, the Gulf War, The Iraq War, and the war in Afghanistan.
The 10 oz. Silver Bullet .50 Caliber Rounds pay homage to this classic era of gun manufacturing, making them an excellent gift for gun and weapons collectors, as well as an investment in silver bullion. Each bullet serves as a nostalgic symbol of a bygone era, adding a touch of history and significance to any collection.
If you are a fan of unique silver products, Bullion Trading LLC also offers a 1 oz silver bullet, a 2 oz (.308) silver bullet, and a 5 oz silver bullet. The 1 oz silver bullet features a design based on the .45 caliber round, while the 2 oz (.308) silver bullet is modeled after the .308 Winchester round, and the 5 oz silver bullet is modeled after the 12 gauge shotgun shell. All of these bullets are made from .999 pure silver.
